market_mood: Rising Fed rate-hike expectations pushed the 10-year Treasury yield to its highest since 2007, lifting the dollar and knocking gold, while Middle East tension keeps energy markets jumpy with record diesel cracks. On the tech side, Meta's new 'Muse' AI agent and an IonQ quantum breakthrough are grabbing attention ahead of Micron's earnings.

picks.reason: Meta's new Muse AI agent is being called its 'ChatGPT moment' and lands right as the Connect developer keynote takes place, which can drive sentiment and product momentum.
Shares rose on a report that activist Toms Capital is pushing Devon to explore a sale, which often puts a floor under the stock.
The 10-year yield hit its highest since 2007 on Fed rate-hike expectations, and long-dated bond funds fall when yields rise.
IonQ says it demonstrated the industry's first real-time end-to-end error decoder, a technical milestone that sent shares sharply higher premarket.
Trump backing a diesel export ban could trap fuel in the US market and compress the record refining margins that have been boosting refiners.
Shares jumped on a report that Sixth Street is renewing a takeover attempt, a classic deal-speculation catalyst.
Memory maker reports earnings into a still-hot AI chip cycle.

watchlist_notes.note: Broad stocks slipped as the 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007, a headwind for valuations.
Rate-hike fears pressure high-multiple tech, but Meta's AI buzz and chip optimism are offsetting positives.
Higher yields and a stronger dollar weigh on Dow multinationals; no company-specific Dow news today.
No major news today, though a stronger dollar is a mild headwind for overseas revenue.
Microsoft picked up an analyst upgrade, a modest positive catalyst.
A top chip analyst reiterated a bullish case on Nvidia and Broadcom despite AI-slowdown chatter.
Amazon and Best Buy expanded their Fire TV partnership to include advertising, a small boost to Amazon's ad business.
No direct headlines, but Meta's well-received Muse AI agent raises competitive pressure in consumer AI.
Wall Street is abuzz over Meta's 'Muse' AI agent ahead of Zuckerberg's Connect keynote today.
No major news today; higher interest rates generally make financing car purchases costlier.
Banks gained in the UK and higher long-term yields can help lending margins, a mild positive.
Crude sits near two-week lows but diesel cracks hit a record and Trump backs a diesel export ban, a mixed picture for refining-heavy majors.
Gold lost ground as rate-hike bets drove the dollar to a near two-month high.
Long bonds are under pressure with the 10-year yield at its highest since 2007.

top_buys.pitch: Meta's 'Muse' AI agent is drawing ChatGPT-level buzz on the day of its Connect keynote.
top_buys.why: CNBC reports the tech world and Wall Street are excited about Muse, and a well-received consumer AI agent would show Meta is converting its heavy AI spending into products people actually use. The Connect keynote gives a near-term stage for announcements that could keep momentum going. Meta already has enormous distribution across its apps, so any successful AI feature scales fast.
top_buys.risks: Hype around AI launches often fades quickly, and rising interest rates pressure expensive tech valuations; heavy AI capex could also disappoint investors focused on margins.
top_buys.watch: The Connect keynote details and any user-adoption or monetization metrics for Muse in coming weeks.

top_buys.pitch: An activist investor is reportedly pushing Devon Energy toward a sale.
top_buys.why: Toms Capital is said to be urging a sale, and activist pressure at an energy producer often leads to buybacks, asset sales or a takeover premium. Devon is a large, low-cost US shale producer, so it would be a digestible target for a bigger major. Energy shares also get support if Iran tensions re-ignite supply worries.
top_buys.risks: Activist campaigns frequently fail to produce a deal, and crude near two-week lows would hurt cash flow if prices keep sliding.
top_buys.watch: Any confirmation from Devon's board or formal activist filing, plus oil price direction around the Iran standoff.

top_buys.pitch: Memory maker reports earnings into a still-hot AI chip cycle.
top_buys.why: Micron's earnings are the near-term event that the market is positioning for, and analysts remain bullish on AI chip demand broadly, including Nvidia and Broadcom. High-bandwidth memory is a key bottleneck for AI servers, so strong guidance could re-rate the stock. The AI hardware theme has been one of the few areas resisting the rate-driven selloff.
top_buys.risks: Memory is cyclical and the stock has run hard, so anything short of a big beat-and-raise can trigger a sharp drop; higher rates also hit richly valued semis.
top_buys.watch: Micron's earnings report and guidance, especially HBM capacity commentary.

top_buys.pitch: IonQ claims the first real-time end-to-end quantum error decoder, a genuine technical milestone.
top_buys.why: Error correction is the main barrier to useful quantum computing, so a working real-time decoder is a meaningful proof point and shares rallied on the news. Investor enthusiasm for 'next big thing' compute themes is running high alongside AI. Any follow-on government or enterprise contracts could extend the move.
top_buys.risks: Quantum stocks are highly speculative, unprofitable and extremely volatile, and single-announcement rallies often reverse within days.
top_buys.watch: Independent validation of the result and IonQ's next bookings or contract announcements.

top_buys.pitch: Sixth Street is reportedly renewing its takeover effort for the annuities insurer.
top_buys.why: Reports of a revived buyout attempt pushed shares up, and a second run at a target often signals serious intent. Higher long-term Treasury yields also improve the economics of annuity and life insurance books, making Brighthouse more attractive to a buyer. The stock has long traded well below book value, leaving room for a premium.
top_buys.risks: This is press speculation only and a previous attempt already collapsed; if talks fail again, the recent gain would likely unwind.
top_buys.watch: Any company confirmation of talks or a formal offer from Sixth Street.
